comment: Set the Vercel project's Root Directory to `frontend` so this file is the one
that applies. Then set VITE_API_BASE as a build-time environment variable to the
absolute URL of your API, including the /api/v1 suffix — on Vercel the bundle and
the API are different origins, so the frontend's default of resolving the API
relative to the page will not find it. See docs/DEPLOYMENT.md.
The rewrite is a safety net rather than a necessity: the app keeps its tab state
in React rather than in the URL, so it has no deep links to fall back on. Vercel
checks the filesystem BEFORE applying rewrites, so favicon.png, the logo assets
and /assets/* are still served as themselves.
